pages.text: $(bold)Inverted Spear of Heaven$()$(br2)A legendary cursed tool (uses vanilla weapon logic — not a Tinkers' tool), purchased from $(bold)Mo Mo (Weapon Merchant)$(): the first two cursed-tool shelf slots of his daily stock randomly refresh between the Inverted Spear of Heaven / Prison Realm, for $(bold)10–20 Ghroth Remains$() (obtained by mining Ghroth Ore at the top of the Nether).$(li)base damage $(bold)24$(), attack speed the same as a sword$(li)$(bold)infinite durability$() — never breaks$(li)$(bold)undead bonus +6$(): deals 6 extra damage when hitting undead such as zombies / skeletons$(li)accepts $(bold)sword enchantments$() (Sharpness, Fire Aspect, etc.)

$(bold)Domain Destruction$(): while holding it, right-click a $(bold)Domain Boundary block$() to destroy that domain directly; if the domain is in the middle of a $(bold)domain clash$(), both domains $(bold)collapse at the same time$() and enter Technique Burnout (exempt in Creative mode). When a domain is destroyed, each boundary block has a $(bold)1/100$() chance to drop a $(l:cursed_tools/item_boundary_fragment)Boundary Fragment$().$(br2)$(bold)Ignores Limitless$(): the Inverted Spear of Heaven bypasses the defenses of "$(l:techniques/wuliang_wuxian)Infinity$()" and deals damage directly.$(br2)$(bold)Dispels shikigami$(): attacking a shikigami already on the field $(bold)removes it outright$() (interrupting the shikigami summoning).$(br2)$(bold)Technique interruption$():$(li)right-clicking a $(bold)shikigami / puppet / Black Bird$() → instantly kills that summon$(li)right-clicking a $(bold)Sweet Berry bush of the Plant Manipulation technique$() → immediately clears that root field (stops the follow-up slow / damage and restores the blocks)$(li)attacking / right-clicking a $(bold)player who is casting a technique$() → interrupts their Black Bird, puppet and plant (charge + root field), the charging of Furnace: Open / Blue, an active Infinity, a domain, and the Projection freeze penalty, and kills the shikigami on the field$(li)every interruption emits $(bold)dark-red particles$() (soot + crimson spores)
